machine: MacBook Pro M3 Pro, 11 cores, 18 GB, macOS 14.4
workload: 7 lecture videos (MIT OCW, 47-84 min each) indexing concurrently: faster-whisper small.en int8 on CPU, SigLIP + bge on MPS, RapidOCR on CPU; 60 s chunks
method: chunks completed per minute measured over an 18 min window (3 workers) and a 15 min window (2 workers) via GET /api/videos; load average from `uptime`

results.note: load climbing over the window; CPU ~890% across the three processes
load flat; each worker settles at ~350% CPU

finding: On one machine, 2 workers out-index 3: CTranslate2 (Whisper) already multithreads inside each worker, so a third process only adds contention. Horizontal scaling is for separate machines / GPU workers, not for oversubscribing one CPU.
